pos.personaBrief: Cruzeiro 2003 was built around the technical playmaker Alex (Trivela, verified) and Luxemburgo's sides are described as imposing themselves with the ball; no counter-attack evidence in the spell.

pro.personaBrief: A team armed around a creative meia and the Luxemburgo stated view that you must build to what players offer, with a pragmatic accepted long ball (2023 quote, weak), suggests mostly patient build-up with direct options.

est.personaBrief: Luxemburgo's documented model is a back four with zonal marking and defined shapes, but with a free-roaming playmaker (Alex) at the centre of the team.

lar.personaBrief: Team organized around the central playmaker Alex (Trivela), with width coming from full-backs like Maurinho and Maicon; the centre carries the best players.

blo.personaBrief: No pressing evidence exists; a dominant treble team with ball control suggests a mid-to-high compact block, not a deep one.

mar.personaBrief: Luxemburgo is documented with zonal marking and a back four (Palmeiras 1993, retrospective), and nothing suggests a change at Cruzeiro.

pla.personaBrief: He shapes the team around the players he finds (Alex bet, stated view that a team is assembled according to what players can offer), and adapts his plans.

res.personaBrief: A pragmatic winner who built a team to win (treble, 'montado para ganhar'), with a result-driven mentality.

sis.personaBrief: He built the team around Alex and used his stars, but with the boss imposing duties on all; mixed talent and system.

jog.personaBrief: He bet on the technical meia Alex and gave a classic playmaker a place, while teams needed intensity to compete.

bas.personaBrief: The Cruzeiro squad used veterans like Zinho (36) and signings picked for the group (Itatiaia, Trivela), not academy-first.

lid.personaBrief: He calls himself the boss ('Eu sou o treinador, eles não são') and in 1998 told Marcelinho 'eu sou o comandante', but he backed Alex personally.
